test.title: A course you would like to study in the future

document.cue: Describe a course you would like to study in the future.

text: The course I'd really like to do is a master's degree in urban planning. I'm currently finishing a bachelor's in civil engineering, and over the last couple of years I've realised that I'm more interested in how whole cities are designed than in calculating loads for individual buildings.

Ideally, I'd like to study it in the Netherlands, because Dutch cities are famous for their cycling routes and public spaces, and several universities there offer the programme in English. A one-year course would also be more affordable than a two-year one elsewhere.

To get onto the programme, I'll need an overall band of at least 6.5 in IELTS, which is exactly why I'm preparing now, as well as a strong motivation letter and two references from my professors. I'm also planning to apply for a scholarship, because without one it would be very hard to cover the living costs.

The main reason I want to study it is that cities in Kazakhstan are growing incredibly fast, and I'd love to help make them greener and easier to live in. Traffic in Almaty, for example, is a daily problem that better planning could genuinely improve.
So it's an ambitious plan, but it feels like the right next step for me, and I'm determined to make it happen.
